method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 哈蒂回到家时发现温迪站在前廊透过窗户往里窥视。
facts.anchor: When she gets back home, Wendy is on the front porch peering through one of the windows.

facts.fact: 温迪说自感恩节以来就没怎么见到哈蒂，想过来看看她。
facts.anchor: We haven’t seen you much since Thanksgiving and I wanted to check on you.

facts.fact: 温迪邀请哈蒂今晚过来吃她要做的千层面。
facts.anchor: Did you want to come over for dinner tonight? I was going to make lasagna.

facts.fact: 温迪说朱尔斯一直在问起哈蒂。
facts.anchor: Jules has been asking about you.

facts.fact: 温迪在门口告诉哈蒂朱利安过得真的很好。
facts.anchor: Julian’s doing really good. In case you were wondering.

facts.fact: 汤米告诉哈蒂他找到了伊林的妻子。
汤米说他是通过搜查各行政区的房产记录找到的。
facts.anchor: I searched through property records in the boroughs.

facts.fact: 记录显示罗斯和娜塔莉·伊林是布朗克斯一处房产的登记所有人。
facts.anchor: A Ross and Natalie Eeling are listed as owners for a place in the Bronx.

facts.fact: 哈蒂意识到自与汤米重逢以来她一次也没陷入恍惚、也没看见过猫头鹰。
facts.anchor: it occurs to her that she hasn’t lapsed into a fugue or seen the owl since their reunion.
